service.method: SELECT HOUSE_CODE , COMPANY_CODE , COMPANY_NAME FROM USERVICE WHERE HOUSE_CODE <> '000' AND COMPANY_CODE = '1000' AND HOUSE_CODE = $S{HOUSE_CODE} AND #DB_OWNER#NVL(DEL_FLAG, 'N') = 'N' AND ( UPPER( HOUSE_CODE ) LIKE '%' + UPPER( $S{F_KEYWORD} ) + '%' OR UPPER( COMPANY_CODE ) LIKE '%' + UPPER( $S{F_KEYWORD} ) + '%' OR UPPER( COMPANY_NAME ) LIKE '%' + UPPER( $S{F_KEYWORD} ) + '%')
SELECT DISTINCT GRID_ID FROM SGRID WHERE HOUSE_CODE = '000' AND UPPER(GRID_ID) LIKE '%' + UPPER($S{F_KEYWORD}) + '%' ORDER BY GRID_ID

SELECT LANG.CONTENTS AS CONTENTS , GRID.HOUSE_CODE , GRID.GRID_ID , GRID.CODE , GRID.COL_TYPE , #DB_OWNER#NVL(GRID.NOT_NULL, 0) NOT_NULL , GRID.COL_FORMAT , LANG.GRID_WIDTH AS COL_WIDTH , GRID.COL_ALIGN , GRID.COL_VISIBLE , GRID.COL_SEQ , GRID.COL_COLOR , GRID.COL_SORT FROM SGRID GRID LEFT OUTER JOIN SLANG LANG ON GRID.HOUSE_CODE = LANG.HOUSE_CODE AND GRID.GRID_ID = LANG.SCREEN_ID AND GRID.CODE = LANG.CODE AND LANG.LANGUAGE = ${session.LANGUAGE} WHERE GRID.GRID_ID = ${GRID_ID} AND GRID.HOUSE_CODE = '000' AND ( 1=1 AND upper(GRID.CODE) like '%' + upper($S{F_KEYWORD}) + '%' OR upper(LANG.CONTENTS) like '%' + upper($S{F_KEYWORD}) + '%' ) ORDER BY GRID.COL_SEQ, CODE

SELECT GRFT.HOUSE_CODE , GRFT.GRID_ID , GRFT.CODE , GRFT.COL_TYPE , GRFT.NOT_NULL , GRFT.COL_FORMAT , GRFT.COL_ALIGN , GRFT.COL_SORT , GRFT.COL_COLOR , GRFT.COL_SEQ , LANG.CONTENTS , LANG.GRID_WIDTH AS COL_WIDTH FROM SGRFT GRFT LEFT OUTER JOIN SLANG LANG on LANG.HOUSE_CODE = GRFT.HOUSE_CODE and LANG.SCREEN_ID = GRFT.GRID_ID and LANG.CODE = GRFT.CODE and LANG.LANGUAGE = ${session.LANGUAGE} where GRFT.HOUSE_CODE = ${HOUSE_CODE} AND GRFT.GRID_ID = ${GRID_ID}
